claims.statement: The Xcode fragment describes opening extension Settings directly or through Editor, Copilot, and Open Copilot for Xcode Settings in an active workspace, then selecting the MCP tab and Edit Config. This is configuration-entry navigation only; it supplies no server definition, supported-version floor, authentication, policy approval, or successful connection. No configuration was edited.

The personal-settings fragment describes opening Copilot settings from the upper-right profile-picture menu. It does not identify an effective policy, authenticated account, subscription entitlement, permission to modify credentials or billing, or completed setting change.
